Questions

How do I get the playbook after I buy?

Right after checkout you'll get an email with your download link. Check your promotions or spam folder if it hasn't arrived within ten minutes.

What level are these for?

Any coach who wants a clear game model: high school, club, academy and college. Every drill includes easier and harder versions so you can adjust to your players.

Can I print them?

Yes. They're letter-size PDFs built to print, so you can hand pages to your staff or players.

Which one should I start with?

Start with the system you play: the 4-3-3, 4-2-3-1 or 3-4-2-1. Then add Rotations and Third Man Runs for your attack and the Press for your defence. Or grab a free preview of any book first.
